definitions.aggregation: pooled pair mean and equal-weight question means among questions with at least one pair, with denominator
definitions.complete: original frozen native_eos only; other stops separately counted
definitions.correct: original frozen Boolean, all eight attempts in denominator
definitions.equation_jaccard_empty: both empty -> 1, one empty -> 0; empty-union count disclosed
definitions.equation_set: lexical expressions inside LaTeX math delimiters, plus un-delimited single-line equations; Unicode NFKC, whitespace removed
definitions.length: original physical returned token count; logical retained tokens also reported
definitions.pairs: all 28 original within-question pairs first; usable-unique pairs separate, never a replacement
definitions.rouge_L: F1 of exact longest common subsequence of whitespace-separated answer-segment tokens; case preserved
definitions.token_cost: all eight physical returned tokens, including bad/capped/duplicate, divided by usable unique count
definitions.usable_unique: native EOS, parsed correct; original normalized full-answer key; first occurrence per question
